title: 사법정책자문위원회 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00009:part:1/1

Article 7 (Meetings)
(1) The chairperson shall convene meetings of the Committee where deemed necessary or upon request by a majority of the incumbent members.
(2) A meeting shall open with the attendance of a majority of incumbent members, and resolutions shall be adopted with the affirmative vote of a majority of the members present.
(3) Adoption of only the majority opinion on an agenda item as a recommendation shall require the affirmative vote of at least two thirds of the members present. Where a majority opinion supported by more than half of the members present does not obtain the approval of at least two thirds of the members present, the majority opinion and the minority opinion with the next highest support shall both be adopted as recommendations.
(4) Meetings shall, in principle, not be open to the public: Provided, That they may be made public following a resolution of the Committee.
(5) The secretary shall record the course of proceedings and a summary of the contents of meetings in minutes, and the chairperson and the secretary who prepared the minutes shall sign or affix their seals thereto.
